Hi Marta,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. I heard from your side that procurement is doing an additional vendor onboarding audit which might push signature/PO timing into next week. We absolutely want you to keep momentum with the integration tests your team started.

Quick proposal: we can grant a one-off 7-day pilot continuity (temporary top-up of 75,000 tokens + sandbox seat extension) to keep your environment live until the PO completes. This is a manual exception from our standard trial limits but straightforward to apply.

If that works, can you confirm: (1) who in procurement is owning the audit (email), and (2) an expected PO date range? We’ll attach a draft PO stub for your procurement team to expedite if helpful (attached).

No cost change — just a short runway to avoid losing the integration progress. If procurement prefers a different mechanism (DocuSign stub, letter of intent), we can support that too.

Thanks,

Expected timing: we hope to complete the audit and route the PO by Friday (26 Nov), but it might slip to early next week (29–30 Nov). Procurement contact is Carlos Ruiz (carlos.ruiz@medivio.com) — I’ve looped procurement in.
